examples.text: Você já foi testemunha num caso de tribunal?
examples.en: Have you ever been a witness in a court case?

examples.text: Quando o juiz fala, todos no tribunal ouvem.
examples.en: When the judge speaks, everyone in the courtroom listens.

examples.text: Tom foi intimado a comparecer no tribunal.
examples.en: Tom has been subpoenaed to appear in court.

examples.text: O tribunal julgou-o culpado e o sentenciou a ser fuzilado.
examples.en: The court found him guilty and ordered him shot.
